description: Turn supplied SEO opportunities into a capacity-aware content calendar and execution plan. Uses AgentSEO credits; repeating the call can create new charged work.

goal.description: Primary business outcome used to prioritize the proposed content plan. Type: String. Accepted values: "traffic_growth", "lead_generation", "refresh_decay", "launch_support", "authority_building". Default: "traffic_growth".

horizon_days.description: Planning horizon measured in calendar days. Type: Safe integer. Minimum: 7. Maximum: 90. Default: 30.

items.description: Supplied opportunities or tasks to prioritize and schedule; this creates a plan, not CMS posts or calendar events. Type: Array. Minimum: 1 items. Maximum: 100 items. Required.
One supplied opportunity or work item to prioritize. Type: Object. Required.

buyer_stage.description: Buyer-journey stage associated with this page or opportunity. Type: String. Accepted values: "awareness", "consideration", "decision", "implementation", "retention". Default: "awareness".

dependencies.description: Names or labels of prerequisite work items that should be completed first. Type: Array. Maximum: 10 items. Default: [].

items.description: One prerequisite work-item title or label. Type: String. Minimum: 1 characters. Maximum: 160 characters. Required.

effort.description: Relative planning effort: small uses 1 capacity point, medium 2 and large 4; these are not hours. Type: String. Accepted values: "small", "medium", "large". Default: "medium".

impact_score.description: Supplied impact score on a 0-100 scale, with larger values indicating greater expected impact. Type: Number. Minimum: 0. Maximum: 100. Optional; no client default.

keyword.description: Search keyword or phrase to analyze for this workflow. Type: String. Minimum: 1 characters. Maximum: 120 characters. Optional; no client default.

notes.description: Additional supplied context relevant to this record; exclude credentials and unnecessary personal data. Type: String. Maximum: 1000 characters. Optional; no client default.

opportunity_type.description: Kind of planned SEO work used to prioritize and route this item. Type: String. Accepted values: "new_content", "refresh", "technical_fix", "internal_links", "schema", "backlink_outreach", "monitoring". Default: "new_content".

priority.description: Supplied urgency level used when ordering the work. Type: String. Accepted values: "low", "medium", "high", "critical". Default: "medium".

source_endpoint.description: AgentSEO API path that produced the opportunity, for example /content/gap; provenance only, not an endpoint to execute. Type: String. Maximum: 120 characters. Optional; no client default.

status.description: Current workflow state of the supplied work item. Type: String. Accepted values: "idea", "ready", "blocked", "in_progress". Default: "idea".

title.description: Title of the supplied page or work item, used as its human-readable label. Type: String. Minimum: 1 characters. Maximum: 180 characters. Required.

url.description: Absolute URL of the page associated with this planned work item; provenance only, not a fetch or publish request. Type: String. Format: absolute URL. Optional; no client default.

start_date.description: Planning start date in YYYY-MM-DD calendar-date format; omit to let the service choose a start date. Type: String. Format must match /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/. Optional; no client default.

sync.description: Request a bounded wait for completion when true. The API can still return a pending job; retain its job ID and poll agentseo_job_status instead of repeating this charged call. False returns a queued job without waiting. Type: Boolean. Default: true.

target.description: Your target brand, domain or URL used to scope this workflow; supply the entity you want assessed. Type: String. Optional; no client default.

team.description: Team member or role labels available for assignment in the plan; use roles instead of personal details when possible. Type: Array. Maximum: 20 items. Default: [].

items.description: One available team role or member label for planning assignments. Type: String. Minimum: 1 characters. Maximum: 80 characters. Required.

weekly_capacity.description: Weekly planning capacity in effort points, not hours or item count. Small tasks use 1 point, medium 2 and large 4; overflow can be placed in the final planning week. Type: Safe integer. Minimum: 1. Maximum: 25. Default: 5.

name: agentseo_content_action_plan
title: AgentSEO Content Action Plan
